title: Contact Callsun
seoTitle: Contact Callsun | Request Solar Module & Storage System Quote
metaDescription: Request a Callsun quote for solar modules, grid-tied systems, off-grid systems, home storage or distributor partnership. Inquiry form includes UTM and source tracking.
h1: Request a Callsun solar product or system quote.

hero.description: Tell us your market, application, project size and target timeline. The inquiry endpoint already captures source tracking and can connect to CRM in the next phase.

form.title: Send project requirements
form.description: Required fields are kept short for conversion. Optional fields help the sales team prepare a more useful first reply.
form.successMessage: Inquiry received. A Callsun sales contact can follow up with product options, package references and document links.
form.mockModeNote: Current phase: /api/inquiry works in mock mode. Later this can connect to HubSpot, Feishu Bitable or Cloudflare D1.

sidebar.contactDescription: Official phone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn and TikTok will be added after the customer provides final contact information.

trustCards.title: What to include
trustCards.description: Target product, application, market, estimated capacity or quantity, timeline and certification requirements.

trustCards.title: What happens next
trustCards.description: The sales team can match the inquiry to products, system packages, case references and downloadable documents.

trustCards.title: Tracking ready
trustCards.description: UTM, referrer, landing page, form source and campaign fields are already reserved for later CRM attribution.
